title.zh: 布伦特原油月度涨幅预警

summary.zh: 2026-09 月度基准环比上涨 28.5%。这是价格 / 成本压力筛查，实际粮食供应影响需进一步核对。
summary.en: The 2026-09 monthly benchmark increased 28.5% from the preceding calendar month. This screens price/cost pressure; food-supply consequences need separate evidence.

rule.zh: WFL 筛查：相邻完整月份涨幅 ≥10% 为黄、≥20% 为红；直接由经单位校验的数值重新计算。
rule.en: WFL screen: ≥10% between adjacent complete months is yellow; ≥20% is red. Recalculated from values with validated units.

title.zh: 布伦特原油月度涨幅预警

summary.zh: 2026-09 月度基准环比上涨 28.5%。这是价格 / 成本压力筛查，实际粮食供应影响需进一步核对。
summary.en: The 2026-09 monthly benchmark increased 28.5% from the preceding calendar month. This screens price/cost pressure; food-supply consequences need separate evidence.

rule.zh: WFL 筛查：相邻完整月份涨幅 ≥10% 为黄、≥20% 为红；直接由经单位校验的数值重新计算。
rule.en: WFL screen: ≥10% between adjacent complete months is yellow; ≥20% is red. Recalculated from values with validated units.

reason.zh: 16/16 个代表点通过连续性、来源和时效检查；最新观测最多允许滞后 10 天。
reason.en: 16/16 representative points pass continuity, source and freshness checks; latest observations may lag by at most 10 days.

reason.zh: 资料日期尚未可靠核实；暂停自动干旱判定。
reason.en: Observation date has not been reliably verified; automatic drought screening is paused.

reason.zh: 0/16 个点有有效当月数据及 1991–2020 同月基准；部分月份仅作背景，不触发红色预警。
reason.en: 0/16 points have usable current-month data and 1991–2020 same-month normals; partial months are context only and never trigger red alerts.

reason.zh: 月度数据缺失、过期或未通过单位 / 日期校验。
reason.en: Monthly data missing, stale, or failed unit/date validation.

reason.zh: 5/5 个成本序列可评估；使用完整月份环比。
reason.en: 5/5 cost series can be evaluated, using complete-month changes.

reason.zh: 仅检查背景资料更新；ENSO 强度和历史倾向不会直接触发作物预警。
reason.en: Context freshness only; ENSO strength and historical tendencies never directly trigger crop alerts.

reason.zh: 21 个作物窗口可匹配。模板是估计生育期，仍需人工维护；不是实测田间进度。
reason.en: 21 crop windows can be matched. Templates estimate growth stages and require editorial maintenance; they are not measured crop progress.

automatic.zh: NASA POWER 代表点高温与生育期重叠、日期被官方可用范围证实的短期干旱图层、FAO 与世界银行完整月份价格 / 成本涨幅。每日重新检查；源数据按各自发布节奏更新。
automatic.en: Representative-point NASA POWER heat/stage overlap, official short-term drought layers with availability-corroborated dates, and complete-month FAO/World Bank price and cost rises. Rechecked daily; source observations follow provider publication schedules.

manual.zh: 政策、战争、地区季节预报和产量影响仍需人工核实。ENSO 与土壤湿度作背景；未自动推断受灾面积、减产比例或全球危机概率。
manual.en: Policy, conflict, regional seasonal forecasts and yield consequences still require review. ENSO and soil moisture provide context; affected area, yield loss and global crisis probabilities are not automatically inferred.
